one_liner: Scans three live trading venues at one pinned block, prices every cross-venue cycle with real math, nets out fees and gas — then acts, or skips with a machine-readable reason.
what_it_does: This lamp watches three live token pools for price differences and works out whether a buy-here-sell-there trade would actually profit after fees and gas. When the math said go, it executed; when it didn't, it skipped and recorded the exact reason. Proven by 21 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, including the two legs of a live profitable arbitrage, all linked below.
